<reason>A won a competitive debate by keeping the motion as a high-bar equal-treatment rule and forcing B into a near-immunity position that could not explain why subsidized campaign machinery should stay tax-free when identical work costs secular charities their status. B’s theologian/chilling frame was memorable and live, but it did not neutralize subsidy-plus-neutrality after B already conceded some partisan operations forfeit advantages.</reason>
